r2_objects_lease_check.name: r2_objects_lease_check
r2_objects_lease_check.value: ("r2_objects"."state" = 'deleting' and "r2_objects"."lease_token" is not null and "r2_objects"."lease_expires_at" is not null) or ("r2_objects"."state" <> 'deleting' and "r2_objects"."lease_token" is null and "r2_objects"."lease_expires_at" is null)

r2_objects_deleted_at_check.name: r2_objects_deleted_at_check
r2_objects_deleted_at_check.value: ("r2_objects"."state" = 'deleted' and "r2_objects"."deleted_at" is not null) or ("r2_objects"."state" <> 'deleted' and "r2_objects"."deleted_at" is null)
